01 / The idea

What if every charger could become part of the network?

Across homes, apartments and workplaces, EV chargers spend hours unused. At the same time, drivers are searching for convenient places to charge. Electrosphere connects the two.

02 / How it works

Powered by people.

02 / SHARED

03 / Our vision

One charger. One connection.
A network that grows with us.

We believe the future of EV charging can extend beyond traditional stations. Homes, workplaces and communities can become connected points in a distributed charging network.
